input.content: You are an independent PLC verification engineer. Return ONLY a JSON list of test cases.

You are an independent PLC test engineer. Generate comprehensive unit test cases for the specified PLC function block.
CODESYS Simulation Timing & Edge Rules:
- dt_ms advances elapsed PLC scan time for that step; TON/TOF timers accumulate dt_ms across consecutive steps while IN keeps its active state (e.g., IN=TRUE for TON).
- Rising-edge detection (R_TRIG or x AND NOT prev_x) requires a step with x=FALSE before the step with x=TRUE.

Return a JSON array of test case objects. Each test case must have:
- id: string identifier (e.g. 'case_1')
- steps: array of steps, where each step has:
    - inputs: dictionary of input variable names and values
    - expected: dictionary of expected output variable names and values
    - dt_ms: (optional) cycle elapsed time in milliseconds

TASK SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF005",
  "title": "Three phase signal with externally clocked durations",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "requirements": "# SELF005: Three-Phase Cyclic Traffic Light Controller\n\n## Background\nThree-phase traffic signal (`RED=0`, `GREEN=1`, `AMBER=2`) stepping on logical `Tick` pulses.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Enable` and `Tick` (`BOOL`). Phase durations are fixed logical tick thresholds: `RED: 2`, `GREEN: 3`, `AMBER: 1`.\n2. Whenever `Enable = FALSE`, reset phase to `RED (0)` and elapsed tick counter `age := 0`.\n3. When `Enable = TRUE` and `Tick = FALSE`, keep current phase and `age` unchanged.\n4. When `Enable = TRUE` and `Tick = TRUE`, increment `age`; when `age` reaches the current phase threshold (`2`, `3`, `1`), advance `(phase + 1) mod 3` and reset `age := 0`.\n5. Outputs follow post-transition phase: `Phase := phase`, `Red <-> (phase = 0)`, `Green <-> (phase = 1)`, `Amber <-> (phase = 2)`.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Enable: BOOL`, `Tick: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Red: BOOL`, `Green: BOOL`, `Amber: BOOL`, `Phase: USINT`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `phase=0`, `elapsed_ticks=0`, `Red=true`, `Green=false`, `Amber=false`, `Phase=0`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\n`Tick` is a logical invocation count (`1` count per scan where `Tick = TRUE`), not physical `dt_ms` time.",
  "scenario": "A training traffic signal uses a deterministic logical tick, allowing reproducible testing without wall-clock timing jitter.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Enable",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Enable normal signal cycle"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Tick",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "One logical tick on each TRUE invocation"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Red",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Red lamp"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Green",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Green lamp"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Amber",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Amber lamp"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Phase",
      "type": "USINT",
      "description": "Post-scan phase number"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "phase": 0,
    "elapsed_ticks": 0,
    "Red": true,
    "Green": false,
    "Amber": false,
    "Phase": 0
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Disable resets the cycle to RED"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "A logical tick is not claimed to be a physical second.",
    "No opposite road or pedestrian signal is controlled.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Enable": "I[k].Enable: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Tick": "I[k].Tick: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Red": "O[k].Red: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Green": "O[k].Green: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Amber": "O[k].Amber: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Phase": "O[k].Phase: independently observed post-scan candidate value (USINT); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qRedLast": "Spre.reference.state.phase=0 AND Spre.reference.state.age=1",
    "qGreenLast": "Spre.reference.state.phase=1 AND Spre.reference.state.age=2",
    "qAmber": "Spre.reference.state.phase=2",
    "qPhase": "Spre.reference.state.phase",
    "oneColor": "int(O[k].Red)+int(O[k].Green)+int(O[k].Amber)=1",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.phase=0, O_init.Red=true, O_init.Green=false, O_init.Amber=false, O_init.Phase=0."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P1",
      "formula": "G(oneColor)",
      "explanation": "The lamp encoding is one-hot.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P2",
      "formula": "G(!Enable -> (Red & !Green & !Amber & Phase=0))",
      "explanation": "When Enable is FALSE, immediately force Red (Phase=0) with age reset to 0.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P3",
      "formula": "G((Enable & !Tick) -> (Phase = qPhase))",
      "explanation": "No tick preserves phase.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P4",
      "formula": "G((Enable & Tick & qRedLast) -> Green)",
      "explanation": "The second red tick enters green.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P5",
      "formula": "G((Enable & Tick & qGreenLast) -> Amber)",
      "explanation": "The third green tick enters amber.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P6",
      "formula": "G((Enable & Tick & qAmber) -> Red)",
      "explanation": "One amber tick returns red.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P7",
      "formula": "(G Enable & G(F Tick)) -> (G(F Red) & G(F Green) & G(F Amber))",
      "explanation": "Persistent enable plus infinitely many ticks makes every phase recur; finite traces cannot prove this liveness property.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P8",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G((Red <-> Phase=0) & (Green <-> Phase=1) & (Amber <-> Phase=2) & (Phase>=0 & Phase<=2))",
      "description": "Phase integer output (0..2) always matches the corresponding Red/Green/Amber light output.",
      "explanation": "Previously Phase was left unconstrained except for holding on !Tick.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF005.P9",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G((Enable & Tick & !qRedLast & !qGreenLast & !qAmber) -> (Phase = qPhase))",
      "description": "A Tick prior to completing the 2-tick Red or 3-tick Green dwell must remain in the current phase.",
      "explanation": "Prevents single-tick skipping through Red (needs 2 ticks) or Green (needs 3 ticks).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
Output budget: at most 2 cases, at most 8 steps per case. Use compact JSON. Cover a complete normal path and one important boundary. Keep reasoning concise enough to finish the entire JSON within the output budget.
